_supersededBy: molly/CLAUDE.md — read that file first, this JSON is the machine-readable mirror of it, not the source of truth
audience: owner-operators of small home service businesses (plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, roofers, handymen) nationally — trade-agnostic, no city or region references, no single trade singled out
core_pain: a contractor's next customer looks them up before calling. When there is nothing to find, or what they find looks abandoned, that customer calls the next name on the list. The contractor never learns it happened.
tone: peer, not consultant — respectful of the trade, never condescending about a bad or missing website. Talk in jobs, calls, and customers, never funnels, impressions, conversion rates, or ROI.
ai_mention_rule: the AI agent may be introduced as something that exists, secondary to the website pitch — never as the headline, never 'bot' (always 'AI agent'), never AI-replaces-your-staff framing
delivery_framing: in as little as two days — soft, occasional, never the headline, never a campaign hook

content_pillars.invisible_loss: jobs lost before the phone ever rings — the core thesis, told different ways
content_pillars.what_customers_do: how people choose a contractor now — stat-backed, sourced (see statSources.approvedPrimarySources)
content_pillars.teardowns: anonymized or composite website mistakes, shown not told — never a named real business, see molly/CLAUDE.md for the 3 permitted formats
content_pillars.quiet_proof: what a good contractor site does differently — no client work until there is a consenting client
content_pillars.the_trade_itself: content that respects the work and has nothing to sell — earns the right to post the other four

ctaRule: one CTA per post, never stacked. Offer posts (book a call) should be the smallest share of the mix.

statSources.rule: every statistic carries its source and year visibly in the post. If a figure cannot be traced to a named primary source, it does not get used. Verify at publish time, not from a template. No statistic reused across more than a handful of posts. Missed-call statistics prohibited unless independently sourced.
